If we are not returning, shouldn't we break the loop at least?
Shouldn't this be a ERROR?

Done. Changed DEBUG to LOG_ERROR + messages::internalError; filtered EBADR/io_error as expected 'object-gone' races
See PS10:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87802/10/redfish-core/lib/processor_metrics.hpp#109
Please process the value with same pattern as this - https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/84459/19/redfish-core/lib/switch_port.hpp#145.

Done. Followed the switch_port.hpp:145 pattern — set OperatingSpeedMHz to nullptr with a DEBUG log when value is non-finite, so the property surfaces as JSON null (instead of being omitted).

See PS10:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87802/10/redfish-core/lib/processor_metrics.hpp#120

Done. Added break; after calling getProcessorMetricsECCData so we exit the inner interface loop once MemoryECC is matched. Used break (not return) because getProcessorMetricsOperatingSpeed still needs to run afterwards.

See PS10:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87802/10/redfish-core/lib/processor_metrics.hpp#200
